title: 第11 章 控火篇入门第 12章 宁为玉碎
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 沈回捧着那卷《控火篇》，在床沿坐了许久。
这些时日跟着静明师姐习字，进度比预想中快得多，是以帛书上的字他倒是全都认得。
毕竟两个世界的文字本就有几分相通，再加上穿越后记性似乎也好了不少，那些原本生僻的字词，多看几遍也就记住了。
他将帛书摊开在膝头，凝神细读。
开篇第一句便让他微微挑眉：“世间火分两种，一曰凡火，二曰性火。此术不炼外丹黄白，专修性火。”
性火？
他继续往下看：“所谓性火，即依凭七情六欲为柴，识神为引，点燃命门真火。”
底下是一段修行法门：先闭五感，内观丹田。观想胸中有一蓬心火，初时微弱如豆。而后以自身灵气为薪柴，源源不断添入其中，使火势渐旺。若能时刻保持此火不灭，且能随心顺意收放其热度，是为入门。
正看得入神，意识深处忽然微微一跳。
那熟悉的羊皮纸界面浮现出来，一行字迹清晰映入识海：
【是否消耗100道行点数，学习小五行法·控火篇（入门）？】
沈回一愣。
一百点？
他低头看了看帛书，又看了看那行提示，心中念头转动。
看来学习不同典籍，所需道行点数也不尽相同。
《百草初录》只需十点，这《控火篇》却要一百，想必是因法术修行比单纯的知识要复杂得多。
他瞥了一眼界面右下角的【道行：0（不可分配）】，试探性地在心中默念了一声“确定”。
毫无反应。
界面上的字迹闪了闪，随即淡去，只留下一个冰冷的提示：
【道行点数不足】
沈回倒也并不失望。
一百点，说多不多，说少不少。
按他如今的修炼速度，大约十天就能攒够。
但他心里隐隐有个念头，这法术，他想自己先修来试试。
毕竟若什么都靠“界面”灌顶，那修行岂不是少了许多乐趣？
他将帛书重新展开，一字一句细读起来。
越读越是心惊，越读越是兴奋。
这《控火篇》与他预想的完全不同。
它并非一套按部就班的固定法诀，而更像是一套关于“火”的根本法理。
一种可以让人从中走出自己道路的根基法门。
开篇的“性火”之说，便已点明此术重在内求，而非外借。
沈回盘膝坐定，闭目内观。
丹田深处那团安静的气流微微流转，他试着按照帛书所言，将心神凝聚于胸口，观想一团心火。
起初只是一片空茫，无有动静。
他耐着性子，一遍遍尝试。
灵气在体内流转，却始终无法凝成那“微弱如豆”的火苗。
偶尔有一瞬间，丹田处会微微一热，可还没来得及欣喜，那热意便散去了，仿若幻觉。
他不气馁。
一遍不行，就十遍。
十遍不行，就百遍。
屋里没有更漏，只能凭窗纸外的天色判断时辰。
天亮了又黑，黑了又亮。
沈回足不出户，吃饭早课也不去了，师兄师姐或许是受了师父嘱咐，也没来唤他。
content_en:
Shen Hui held the volume "Fire Control" and sat on the edge of the bed for a long time.
These days of practicing calligraphy with Senior Sister Jingming, the progress was much faster than expected, so he could recognize all the characters on the silk book.
After all, the words in the two worlds are somewhat similar, and my memory seems to have improved a lot after traveling. Those words that were originally unfamiliar can be remembered after reading them a few times.
He spread the silk book on his knees and read it carefully.
The first sentence at the beginning made him raise his eyebrows slightly: "There are two types of fire in the world, one is ordinary fire, and the other is sex fire. This technique does not refine the outer elixir yellow and white, but specializes in sex fire."
Sexual fire?
He continued reading: "The so-called sexual fire means relying on the seven emotions and six desires as firewood, and the consciousness of God as the guide to ignite the true fire of the gate of life."
Below is a practice method: first close the five senses and look inside the Dantian. Visualize that there is a fire in your chest, which is as weak as a bean at first. Then he uses his own spiritual energy as firewood, adding it continuously to make the fire grow stronger. If you can keep this fire unquenched at all times, and if you can control its heat as you please, this is the beginning.
Just as he was watching intently, his consciousness suddenly jumped slightly.
The familiar parchment interface emerged, and a line of writing clearly reflected in the sea of consciousness:
[Would you like to spend 100 Dao Xing points to learn the Small Five Elements Method·Fire Control (Introduction)? 】
Shen Hui was stunned.
One hundred points?
He lowered his head and looked at the silk book, then looked at the line of prompts, and his mind was spinning.
It seems that learning different classics requires different Taoist points.
"The First Record of Baicao" only costs ten points, but this "Fire Control Chapter" costs one hundred points, presumably because magic practice is much more complicated than simple knowledge.
He glanced at [Tao Xing: 0 (not assignable)] in the lower right corner of the interface, and tentatively said "OK" silently in his heart.
No response.
The writing on the interface flashed, then faded away, leaving only a cold reminder:
[Insufficient Taoist points]
Shen Hui was not disappointed.
One hundred points, say more but not more, say less.
According to his current cultivation speed, he can save enough in about ten days.
But there was a vague idea in his mind that he wanted to practice this spell himself first.
After all, if everything depends on the "interface" for initiation, wouldn't it be a lot less fun to practice?
He unfolded the silk book again and read every word carefully.
The more I read, the more frightened I become, and the more I read, the more excited I become.
This "Fire Control Chapter" was completely different from what he expected.
It is not a set of fixed step-by-step methods, but more like a set of fundamental principles about "fire".
A foundational method from which people can find their own path.
The theory of "Xinghuo" at the beginning of the chapter has already pointed out that this technique focuses on seeking from within, rather than borrowing from outside.
Shen Hui sat cross-legged, closed his eyes and looked inside.
The quiet air flow deep in the Dantian was flowing slightly. He tried to follow what the silk book said, focusing his mind on his chest and visualizing a ball of inner fire.
At first it was just empty and motionless.
He patiently tried again and again.
The spiritual energy circulates in the body, but it can never condense into the "weak as a bean" flame.
Occasionally, for a moment, there will be a slight heat in the Dantian, but before I can feel happy, the heat dissipates, just like an illusion.
He is not discouraged.
If one time doesn't work, then ten times.
If ten times doesn't work, just do it a hundred times.
There was no leak in the house, so I could only judge the time by the sky outside the window paper.
The sky is bright and dark, and it is dark and bright again.
Shen Hui stayed at home and did not go to eat or go to class. His senior brothers and sisters, perhaps because of his master's instructions, did not come to call him.
